title: Batch-Binding Time from 5 to 60 Minutes Does Not Limit Capture of His-CasP from Clarified Lysate
authors: Uma Bren, Rafi Vale, and Tess Orin | Simulated Downstream Processing Group
research_question: Does extending Ni-resin batch-binding time from 5 to 60 min improve His-CasP capture, and is resin capacity a separate limitation?
methods: densitometry of bound and flow-through fractions
key_findings: Bound recovery was 73-75% at all standard binding times
Extending time did not improve capture
Low resin reduced recovery to 38% and increased flow-through to 45%
conclusion: Five minutes was sufficient at the standard resin amount; resin capacity, not contact time, limited the low-resin condition.
critical_negations: Longer binding did not improve recovery
The study did not test less than 5 min
The low-resin result should not be attributed to short contact time
forbidden_claims: 60 min gave the highest meaningful recovery
